Draw an ORIGINAL detailed chibi wuxia pixel-art sprite production source sheet, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen isolated full-body drawings, on perfectly flat pure solid green #00ff00 for chroma-key separation. Invisible equal square cells; no grid lines, labels, text, shadows, ground, effects, gradients or trim. Use a square canvas. Each full figure must be separate, centered in its own cell, roughly 64 percent of cell height from topknot to boot. Leave very generous blank green space between columns and around every hammer in the widest pose. At the same camera angle as an elevated 3/4 orthographic Pokémon-like wuxia overworld. Body design and weapons from image 1's SMALL CHIBI. Image 2 is only reference for approved poses and identity, do not bring over any floor or lightning. Use dark pixel-stepped contours, chunky compact full head, tiny sturdy thick-set adult body, strong pale ash-taupe shaggy fur at shoulders and cuffs, short pointed beard, shaved temples and short red-tied topknot, charcoal plum cross-collar wool coat, brick red sash, brown boots and copper-banded bracers. Same small faceted dark-steel hammer with orange/copper Y channel, medium-length chestnut wrapped handle and grip in ONE RIGHT HAND consistently. Free hand for balance; no duplicate weapons. Hero is same identity, height, and game scale across all poses. Consistent scale and foot placement much more important than ornament. Author real distinct key poses, avoid resizing or rotating entire bodies.
Row 1 each left to right: idle neutral; idle breath shoulders slightly up; compact ready to swing with hammer close to shoulder; ready low one-handed stance, all four poses with feet planted.
Row 2: complete four-frame walking loop, FIRST right boot leading and left trailing; SECOND passing pose boots near underneath body; THIRD left boot leading and right trailing (reverse limbs); FOURTH opposite passing pose; hand swings slightly with hammer, no running or jumps.
Row 3: FOUR clearly different hammer strikes using one hand, first low backhand with hammer out and knees bent, second upward forehand with hammer extending high, third forward horizontal sweep with torso turning and hammer extended at waist, fourth overhead DOWNWARD strike that has just made contact with the ground ahead, low forward crouch with hammer head near the boots baseline. Do not draw lightning; silhouette and weapon are all that should be present.
Row 4: ranged attack of pointing, first draws right hand back with hammer, second FULLY EXTENDS RIGHT ARM STRAIGHT and points the hammer handle horizontally along aim direction, third holds the pointed hammer forward with a smaller recoil posture, fourth returns toward guard. Hammer never leaves his hand. No beam/bolt/flash/ground.
All cels use the same required facing for the entire sheet.
Facing EAST (screen right) throughout. Profile or shallow rightward three-quarter view with visible near-side face, nose points right, right arm nearer camera, moves and points the hammer decisively to the right. Distinct poses with feet away from the cell borders.

Edit the original 4x4 green chibi sprite sheet in exactly TWO cells, row 2 columns 3 and 4. Keep the exact canvas layout and all other cels pixel identical in appearance. The camera sees the character from the front (walking downward). Make row 2 column 3 the opposite heel strike of column 1: put the BOOT ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE clearly extended down toward the viewer with its sole visible and boot on the RIGHT SIDE tucked behind and higher. Keep the hammer on the screen LEFT in the same hand. Make row 2 column 4 a narrow passing stance that is visibly different from column 2: the planted boot is on the screen RIGHT, and the other boot on the screen LEFT is rising and passing behind the planted foot. This fixes a limp. Keep artwork completely inside the existing cells with clear green gaps, exactly 16 sprites. Keep true original fur, shoes, face, and palette, no flip of entire body or change of right weapon hand. Edit only the two specified cells and keep the pure green field.

Edit this original 4x4 green chibi sprite sheet for a rear-facing warrior. Keep the same square layout and camera, palette, scales and green field. Modify only row 2 columns 3 and 4 and row 4 columns 2 and 3. Row 2 column 3 must show the opposite gait to column 1: the boot on the RIGHT of the screen is swung backwards toward the viewer, its sole visible, and the boot on the LEFT is planted farther away and higher. Row 2 column 4 is a narrow passing pose, with the opposite boot planting compared with column 2. Keep his hammer in his right hand as viewed from behind. In row 4 columns 2 and 3 he aims the hammer FORWARD IN DEPTH, away from the viewer, heading toward the TOP edge of the image, near the line from right shoulder to the top of the cell. The arm is foreshortened; hand and hammer head appear just above and a few pixels to the right of his shoulder/head. Do not point the hammer horizontally to the right. Keep a clear recognizable hammer silhouette separated from the hair by a tiny green gap where possible while the grip connects to the fist. Face is never visible. Preserve all other poses, especially row 3. Keep clean cell separation, four rows of four original drawings, no text.

Produce one clean original pixel-art lightning animation source sheet for Võ Lâm Hero Defense, using the approved Hắc Thiết hammer storyboard input for style and hues only. Exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows on a completely flat pure chroma green #00FF00 field. Exactly 12 isolated separate sprites with ample blank padding, invisible equal grid, landscape approx 4:3. Keep each entire effect inside its own cell. No character, no hammer, no ground, no enemies, no captions, no guides, no gray shadow, no clouds. Hard crisp stepped pixels with sharp forks, warm golden white cores and occasional lavender tips, restrained glow clustered within 1 to 3 logical pixels. The hue green appears only as the flat background.
Row 1 left to right, four distinctive single quarter-crescent electric hammer melee slash shapes for a hero striking screen-right from an elevated RPG camera: a small low jagged swoosh, a rising sharp hooked slash, a broad horizontal crescent, and an overhead downstroke with a very tight low terminal crack. Open interiors and few flecks. These are separate effects, the actual hero and weapon must not appear.
Row 2 left to right, four separate states of a vertical bolt striking exactly one point below: fine broken just-forming vertical branches; a full brilliant vertical strike tapering down to a compact impact star at the very bottom; narrower dissipating vertical branches and smaller impact at the very bottom; then a tiny fading gold lilac impact burst only, at the same bottom alignment in the cell. Tall first three bolts all centered horizontally and reach down to the same lower portion of their own cell, no ground or target. Keep a narrow vertical bolt silhouette.
Row 3 left to right, four compact little lightning coils to loop around a hammer head, contained in about half of the cell, same center and rough size, only few pointed yellow-white and violet electrical segments around an open center. No hard circle and no solid center fill. Every cell clear and well-separated on flat green. No additional decoration.
